content: Need: v0.6.31 can calculate confidence-versus-outcome calibration, but aggregate reports can still hide selection bias, duplicate or dependent observations, missing outcomes, drift, and high-risk subgroup failure. Intent: add schema-backed Calibration Cohort records with executable inclusion/exclusion rules, duplicate and dependence boundaries, subgroup segments, prevalence and missingness summaries, drift checks, and governance routing in v0.6.32. Context: remain domain-general; do not treat cohort size, coverage percentage, balanced samples, or subgroup counts as quality or representativeness proof.
